title: Fix web NIP-07 unit regressions for availability timers and NIP-44 queue semantics
observed_behavior: NIP-07 availability tests failed when test window objects did not expose window.setInterval.
Late browser extension provider injection needed deterministic notification without fake signer behavior.
NIP-44 queue tests needed to distinguish retryable transient bridge failures from terminal signer rejections.
intended_behavior: Availability probing remains browser-safe and test-deterministic, using timers only for browser extension availability probing and not for Nostr relay delivery or completion.
Late NIP-07 provider injection notifies subscribers without introducing production-path fake signer behavior.
NIP-44 encrypt/decrypt operations serialize against the signer, retry legitimate transient bridge failures, reject terminal signer errors, and leave the queue usable after rejection.
